# Senddot by OdishaBajar.com

> Senddot is the agency-first outbound email infrastructure that agencies own and self-host. Deploy under your own brand, manage unlimited clients, sending domains, and campaigns from one platform. One-time deployment fee plus small monthly maintenance — no per-seat SaaS.

## What Senddot is

- Agency-first: built for agencies running outbound for multiple clients, not for single-team SaaS use.
- Self-hosted and owned: deployed into the agency's own environment and re-branded to the agency.
- Multi-client: isolated workspaces, sending domains, CRM, and reporting per client.
- Deliverability-aware: SMTP rotation pool, SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification, throttling, and telemetry.
- Included modules: campaign builder, lead finder, CRM, sender identities, domain verification, analytics.

## Commercials

- One-time deployment (includes onboarding and re-branding to the agency's identity).
- Small monthly maintenance fee for updates and support.
- No per-seat pricing. Agencies own the platform after deployment.
